none: PAS KENT-4B5B45: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Diadem bust right. Inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Two soldiers holding one standard. Inscription: [GLORI](A EXE)[RCITS]. Mint unidentifiable. Mint mark: -//[]. Reece period 17. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is in fine condition with some wear. It has a dark grey/green patina, the edges are a little irregular with some surface corrosion resulting in a rusty brown stain/encrustation over much of the coin. This coin is likely to date to 335-341AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 62 no. 599A and Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon James, Seaby 1986 reprint…
